{"CommandLine":"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
`$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead('C:\Users\lg\Desktop\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명_fixed.xlsx')
`$sstEntry = `$zip.GetEntry('xl/sharedStrings.xml')
`$sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader(`$sstEntry.Open(), [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
`$sstXml = `$sr.ReadToEnd()
`$sr.Close()
`$matches = [regex]::Matches(`$sstXml, '<t[^>]*>(.*?)</t>')
`$strings = @()
foreach (`$m in `$matches) { `$strings += `$m.Groups[1].Value }

`$s1Entry = `$zip.GetEntry('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
`$sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader(`$s1Entry.Open(), [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
`$sheetXml = `$sr.ReadToEnd()
`$sr.Close()
`$zip.Dispose()

if (`$sheetXml -match '<row[^>]*r=`"1`"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>') {
    `$row1 = `$Matches[1]
    `$cells = [regex]::Matches(`$row1, '<c\s+r=`"([A-Z]+)1`"[^>]*>(?:<v>(\d+)</v>)?')
    foreach (`$c in `$cells) {
        `$col = `$c.Groups[1].Value
        `$valIdx = `$c.Groups[2].Value
        `$text = if (`$valIdx -ne '') { `$strings[[int]`$valIdx] } else { '' }
        Write-Host `"`$col : `$text`"
    }
}
